The sea salt factory is the largest in the world and produces 7 million tonnes of sea salt every
year. The sea salt is extracted from sea water.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
The factory is located on the edge of a shallow area of sea called a lagoon.
Use the map to estimate the area of the lagoon.
Circle the correct answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The photograph shows sea salt that has been extracted from sea water in the lagoon.
Suggest two environmental impacts of this sea salt extraction.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The factory is located in the El Vizcaíno biosphere reserve.
Describe how biosphere reserves conserve biodiversity.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: The photograph shows tourists whale watching in the lagoon.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Whale watching can be managed as sustainable tourism.
Describe what is meant by sustainable tourism.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Suggest three strategies for managing the impacts of whale watching.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
The drawing shows a marine mammal called the vaquita porpoise.
1.5 m
Marine mammals need to come to the surface of the water to breathe air.
The vaquita porpoise is only found in the Sea of Cortez.
In 2015, a survey estimated that there were 60 vaquita porpoises in the wild. In 2021, there
were only 10 vaquita porpoises left in the wild.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Calculate the mean decrease per year in the vaquita porpoise population in the six years
between 2015 and 2021.
Give your answer as a whole number.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Suggest why it is difficult to estimate the population of vaquita porpoises.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Suggest two reasons why commercial fishing is a threat to vaquita porpoises.

The Colorado River is the main source of fresh water for the Baja California peninsula. In
recent years, the river does not supply enough water for the population of the Baja California
peninsula.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Suggest three reasons why the Colorado River does not supply enough water for the
population of the Baja California peninsula.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State two sources of fresh water other than a river.

contain a maximum of 10 mg / dm of nitrate ions.

parts.label: (i)

parts.text:

parts.text:
The local government of the Baja California peninsula have introduced water rationing to
conserve water.
Water rationing is where the water supply to homes and industry is turned off for a few hours
each day.
Suggest two effects of water rationing on the people of the Baja California peninsula.

parts.text:

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Smog regularly forms in Mexico City from vehicle emissions.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Describe how smog forms from vehicle emissions.

parts.label: (ii)

parts.label: (iii)

Smog can cause premature death.
State two other effects of smog on human health.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Suggest two reasons why the orchid has become endangered.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A scientist investigates the population of white nun orchids in a 1000 km area of forest, using
a systematic sampling technique.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Describe how the scientist:
• uses systematic sampling
• collects the data using a transect
• records the data collected
• obtains an estimate for the population of orchids in the forest.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Suggest two limitations of sampling white nun orchids in a 1000 km forest using a
transect.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Seeds from the white nun orchid have been stored in seed banks.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Explain why seeds are stored in seed banks.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
State three limitations of seed banks.
